question: Which deity is prescribed with golden human form, right-hand pointing-finger mudra, left hand at waist, emblem-marked head, and all ornaments?
inference: The verse prescribes Ankushadhari's iconographic form.
plain_english: Ankushadhari is golden and human-formed, has right-hand pointing-finger mudra, left hand at waist, emblem-marked head, and all ornaments.
